_doc: Customer needs registry for ENH-133 Customer Needs & Gap Analysis. Bank-curated canonical needs + segment-level priorities and minimum portfolio expectations. Used by the gap analyzer to flag customers whose product portfolio or service experience falls below segment baseline.

needs.name: Transactional banking
needs.description: Day-to-day account access, payments, transfers, debit card

needs.name: Wealth preservation & growth
needs.description: Long-term value protection through deposits, fixed income, investments

needs.name: Insurance & protection
needs.description: Life, health, asset, and business protection cover

needs.name: Digital convenience
needs.description: Self-service via mobile/internet banking; reliable channels

needs.name: Relationship management & contact cadence
needs.description: Regular advisor contact aligned to segment expectations

needs.name: Retention (proactive churn mitigation)
needs.description: Customer at elevated churn risk needs targeted retention action

needs.name: Service quality recovery
needs.description: Complaints volume above baseline indicates service gap

_notes: Bank-curated registry. Operators tune segment_expectations to match relationship-banking strategy.
Behavioural-signal needs (digital_convenience, retention_risk, service_quality_recovery) are derived from customer_intelligence.json fields, not from products_held.
Propensity-based needs map to data/customer_intelligence.json[customer].propensity_scores ordered list.
Premium segment expects 8+ products held (full bank-of-choice relationship); Mass expects 3+.
ENH-135 CVP Builder will consume this registry's needs[] list as input.
